title: Minimum wage in Soccsksargen to reach P501 daily on January 1
summary: KORONADAL CITY — The daily minimum wage for private workers in the non-agriculture, retail, and service sectors in Soccsksargen (Region 12) will increase to P501 in January 2027 after a P41 wage hike…

blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — The daily minimum wage for private workers in the non-agriculture, retail, and service sectors in Soccsksargen (Region 12) will increase to P501 in January 2027 after a P41 wage hike benefiting 86,815 workers in the region. The National Wages and Productivity Commission (NWPC) said the increase under Wage Order No. XII (SOCCSKSARGEN)-26 would be implemented in two tranches, with the first P16 increase taking effect on Nov. 19 and the remaining P25 on Jan. 1, 2027. With the first tranche, the daily minimum wage for non-agricultural, retail, and service workers will increase from the current P460 to P476. […]...
